intro: Every construction project is different, so we do not publish flat prices we would have to walk back once we see your space. Instead we give you a free, no-obligation estimate after an on-site consultation — a real number based on your actual scope, materials and timeline. What follows is an honest look at what drives the cost of a project, so you know what we are pricing before we quote it. Financing is available through Acorn Finance if you would rather spread the cost out.

cost_table.heading: What drives the cost of your project
cost_table.lede: These are the variables we walk through with you during the consultation, before any number is quoted.
rows: Size of the space, cabinetry and countertop selections, whether plumbing or electrical is being moved, tile and fixture grade.
Square footage, how much is structural, how many rooms are in scope, and whether systems (electrical, plumbing, HVAC) are being updated.
Complexity of the design, whether renderings and permit drawings are needed, and the length of the build phase.
Footprint, roof or screen structure, whether an outdoor kitchen is included, and site and drainage conditions.
Wall size, material selection (tile, stone, millwork), fireplace unit, and any lighting or electrical work.
Number of openings, impact rating, frame material, and whether openings are being resized.
Square footage, code and accessibility requirements, mechanical and electrical scope, and landlord requirements.
Area covered, condition of the existing surface, material grade, and prep or repair work required.
cost_table.footnote: All work is backed by our 1-year workmanship warranty. Estimates are free and there is no obligation.
